Upstream: wireguard_flutter_plus 1.0.7, https://pub.dev/packages/wireguard_flutter_plus/versions/1.0.7
License: MIT; see LICENSE. Dart and desktop implementations are unchanged.

Android changes:
- Add an immutable, explicit service PendingIntent for VPN disconnect.
- Keep one process-owned backend and original Tunnel identity across Flutter engines.
- Notification and app disconnect explicitly call setState(DOWN, null) on that
  original tunnel, verify shutdown, and retain a retry notification on failure.
  stopService alone cannot guarantee a bound VPN service destroys the tunnel.
- Serialize backend state changes and suppress premature notification teardown.
- DOWN stops traffic updates, clears counters, updates Flutter when attached,
  and removes the foreground notification.
- Do not restart the notification-only service after manual stop/process death.
- Preserve the notification title when the action has no display-name extra.
- Notification body opens the app; errors retain a retry action.
- Clear detached event sinks and remove configuration/private-key log output.

Verify on Android: connect, swipe away app, use notification disconnect,
verify VPN key disappears, reopen app, verify disconnected, reconnect with
saved configuration. Also test repeated taps, OS VPN revoke, and force-stop.
Swiping recents is different from Android Settings > Force stop.
